## [1.4.0] - 2026-11-13

### Added
- Save carts for logged-out users for 30 days (#211)
- Dark mode for the account page (#217)

### Changed
- **BREAKING:** Orders endpoint now returns prices in cents (#214)

### Fixed
- Checkout total now applies the discount code on mobile (#213)
- Search box keeps focus after typing the first letter (#215)

### Security
- Password reset links now expire (#219)

## [2.0.0] - 2026-11-20

### Added
- Download invoices as PDF (#301)
- Invite teammates by email (#304)

### Changed
- **BREAKING:** Remove the deprecated /v1/customers endpoint (#305)
- Search results load twice as fast on large catalogues (#308)

### Fixed
- Correct VAT rounding for invoice totals ending in .5 (#303)
- Fix date picker showing the wrong month in Safari (#307)

### Security
- Fix uploaded files being readable by other accounts (#309)

## [0.9.2] - 2026-12-01

### Added
- New `tool doctor` command checks your setup (#42)

### Changed
- **BREAKING:** Config file renamed from `.toolrc` to `tool.toml` (#41)

### Fixed
- Warnings were printed even with the `--quiet` flag (#40)
- Crash on Windows paths containing spaces (#45)

### Security
- Upgrade YAML parser to patch remote code execution (CVE-2026-4411) (#44)

## [3.2.0] - 2026-12-08

### Added
- Offline maps for saved trips (#515)
- Share a trip with a link that expires (#519)

### Changed
- **BREAKING:** Trips endpoint paginates by default, 50 per page (#518)

### Fixed
- Offline edits no longer lost after login (#517)
- Map pins no longer overlap on small screens (#521)

### Removed
- Remove the legacy trip importer (#524)

### Security
- Shared links no longer expose the owner's email address (#522)

## [1.11.0] - 2027-01-05

### Added
- Spell check in the editor for 14 languages (#87)
- Export documents as Markdown (#91)

### Changed
- **BREAKING:** Drop support for Internet Explorer 11 (#93)

### Fixed
- Undo in the editor skipped every second change (#89)
- Tables pasted from Excel lost their borders (#94)

### Security
- Stop writing session tokens to the browser console (#90)

## [4.0.1] - 2027-01-19

### Added
- Pause a subscription for up to 3 months (#706)

### Changed
- **BREAKING:** Annual plans now renew on the purchase date instead of the 1st of the month (#702)

### Fixed
- Receipts showed the wrong currency symbol (#703)
- CSV exports no longer cut off rows after 10,000 (#707)

### Security
- Reject forged webhooks by verifying their signatures (#705)
